主要内容: Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. disclosed that its wholly-owned subsidiary, R. L. Drake Holdings, LLC, acquired substantially all of the assets of R. L. Drake Holdings, LLC, subject to certain specific assumed liabilities. The acquisition was previously reported in a Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on February 7, 2012. Drake Acquisition Corporation and WBMK Holding Company provided audited balance sheets of the seller as of December 31, 2011 and 2010, along with related audited statements of operations, changes in members’ equity, and cash flows. They also included unaudited pro forma combined balance sheets and statements of operations for the year ended December 31, 2011.
